caption:
In the 18 calendar years from 2008 to 2025, the Nifty 50 ended lower in only 3: 2008 (-51.8%), 2011 (-24.6%) and 2015 (-4.1%).

The year after each fall, it ended higher: +75.8% in 2009, +27.7% in 2012 and +3.0% in 2016.

Three instances of past data, not a forecast. Falls are part of the journey; a written plan helps families stay steady.

What helps you stay calm when markets fall?
